description: Land Acquisition - Biyagama, Biyagama D/S Division, Gampaha District.
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a specific order for taking possession of described land parcels, including detailed descriptions of the land boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickramasinghe, this is incidental to the main purpose of the notice, which is land acquisition. The content does not focus on government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the administrative process of acquiring specific land properties.
